spans.text: Belorussky Railway Station, Moscow, Neo-Soviet Union.
Instructor Lyudmila, here is your ticket. Please make sure you don't lose it.
I wish you a pleasant journey.
...Thanks.
Instructor Я nods.
She takes her ticket and drops it into the kraft paper envelope she is holding.
She double-checks her own carriage calmly, then as if arriving at a scheduled meetup, she taps her wristwatch.
Tick...
The hand starts turning as "Lyudmila" slowly opens her eyes, her gaze still lingering on the watch.
She flicks her wrist lightly and pulls her sleeve over the wristwatch. Then her eyes fall on the paper envelope in her hand.
After taking stock of her surroundings, she gives her sleeve another tug and slips quietly into the crowd.
...Hm, let me see what plans you've made, Instructor Я.
Lyudmila locks herself in a restroom at the train station. She opens the envelope and pulls out the things that she is supposed to read through.
First is a profile of the persona that she is adopting. After confirming her false identity, she puts it back into the envelope and pulls out another piece of paper.
...Sheesh, what year is this? We're still passing paper notes?
I suppose it's only wise. We wouldn't have to resort to such antiquated methods if it weren't for enemy infiltration.
She unfolds the note with a sardonic grimace and skims through it, then promptly tears it to pieces.
Whoosh...
Splash...
Lyudmila sets fire to the torn up piece of paper using a discarded cigarette in the ashtray, carefully scoops up the ashes, and flushes them down the toilet.
She washes the ashes off her hands under the faucet.
She only puts on her gloves again after drying her hands meticulously.
Carriage F02, Intercontinental Railway train "Future".
Lyudmila enters the carriage and takes the seat written on her ticket.
Then she pulls out an invitation card from the envelope.
Soon after she settles down, a friendly stewardess comes up to her.
Hello, would you like something to drink?
Tea, please.
She glances up at the stewardess and gives her a brief nod.
Upon receiving a reply, the stewardess immediately takes the hint and walks away.
Lyudmila reaches out and takes a newspaper from the rack next to her seat.
Seven... eight...
She opens the newspaper and seems to be reading the headlines, but is in fact counting in her head.
There are 50 seats in total. 28 passengers are currently on board - eighteen men, seven women, and three children.
As for Dolls... There are six.
12 of these passengers came on board in Moscow.
Lyudmila quietly commits all the passengers' appearances to memory.
Here's your tea.
May I help you with anything else?
Not for the time being, thank you.
Alright. If you need me, just press the button at your seat.
I'll be with you right away.
Lyudmila puts down the newspaper and takes a sip from her cup of tea.
Her gaze follows the brisk and efficient stewardess as she leaves.
There are four train attendants... all Dolls.
Rumble...
The gargantuan beast named "Future" suddenly produces a low rumble, interrupting her thoughts.
Ding-dong...
Welcome on board the Intercontinental Railway Train EN440 13M, "Future". This train is about to depart.
For your personal safety, please keep your seatbelt fastened while the train is in motion.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Retired instructor Lyudmila Pavlichenko, your mission is to infiltrate the underground Doll trafficking hub known as the "Colt Express" and investigate its manager as well as her affiliation.
As expected of Instructor Я... Even the most superficial mission is so carefully thought out.
